sourcedFrom: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions (undated — no copyright line is printed)
cleanIntro: An AK strip: dust cover off, recoil spring out, carrier and bolt out the back, gas tube off. Zastava's own book, one model.

steps.title: Magazine off, safety down to FIRE
steps.action: Take the magazine off the rifle, then slide the safety lever down out of its top notch. The lever has to be down before the handle will draw back far enough to show you the chamber — on an AK the safety is also the bolt-travel stop. Keep the muzzle in a safe direction the whole time.
steps.caution: YOUR FIREARM MUST BE COMPLETELY UNLOADED BEFORE YOU START THE STRIPPING!
steps.quote: Move the SAFETY lever to “FIRE” position by sliding the safety selector down.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 2, p.18

steps.title: Handle back, look into the chamber, ride it home
steps.action: Pull the bolt cocking handle to the rear and hold it there while you look into the chamber for a cartridge. Look, do not feel — the AK ejection port is wide enough to see through. When you are satisfied, let the bolt run forward under control rather than dropping it.
steps.prose: Zastava has you cycle the safety lever again here; that is what releases the carrier from the catch.
steps.quote: Once determined that the chamber is empty, push down on the safety lever and let the bolt go back forward to home position.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 3, pp.18-19

steps.title: Release button in, dust cover up
steps.action: Brace the rifle across your lap or on a table, press the spring-loaded release button through the back of the receiver, and lift the dust cover off from its rear edge. The cover is under spring load from the recoil assembly behind it, so keep a hand on it — released carelessly it flips up and away.
steps.quote: raise the receiver cover from the back end with your other hand.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 4, p.18

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out of the carrier channel
steps.action: Hold the front of the receiver, press the back of the recoil spring cam forward until its rear face clears the groove in the receiver, then lift the cam and draw the whole recoil spring assembly out of the channel in the bolt carrier. It is compressed while you are pressing it — let it extend under control, and keep your face out of line with it.
steps.quote: Lift the recoil spring cam and remove recoil spring assembly from the bolt carrier channel
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 5, p.18
steps.warn: USE PROTECTIVE EYEWEAR TO PREVENT EYE INJURIES!

steps.title: Carrier and bolt back, up, and off the rails
steps.action: Hold the receiver in one hand and the cocking handle in the other and draw the carrier and bolt all the way back until the carrier touches the rear plate. At that point — and only at that point — the carrier can rise off the rails. Ease the pressure on the handle, lift the rear of the carrier, and take carrier and bolt out together.
steps.prose: If it will not lift, it is not far enough back — the cut in the rails is right at the end of travel.
steps.quote: Once the back of the bolt carrier contacts the back plate of the receiver, release pressure on the bolt cocking handle, this will allow the bolt carrier to move up and off the receiver rails.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 6, p.19

steps.title: Bolt out of the carrier
steps.action: Turn the carrier over in your left hand, rotate the top of the bolt to the right and pull it rearward so the guide lug walks out of its channel, then slide the bolt forward out of its hole. Rotate first, then move it — trying to pull it straight out with the lug still in the channel just wedges the two together.
steps.quote: Rotate the top of the bolt to the right and move it rearward with your right hand so that the guide lug on the bolt leaves the channel in the bolt carrier.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 7, p.19

steps.title: Gas tube lever up, tube off
steps.action: Rotate the gas tube locking lever clockwise until it stands vertical, then lift the rear of the tube out of its groove in the rear sight base and slide the front off the gas block. If the lever is stiff, that is fouling in the lever seat, not a reason to lever on it with a screwdriver.
steps.aside: Lift the gas tube end vertically, out of its groove in the rear sight base and slide out the front end of the gas tube from the gas block
steps.quote: Rotate the gas tube locking lever (see picture #16) clockwise, untill it’s in vertical position and gas tube is unlocked.
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, step 8, p.19

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Dust cover, recoil spring assembly, bolt carrier, bolt and gas tube with upper handguard are off. That is the whole strip Zastava publishes for the ZPAPM70. Cleaning is next; there is no deeper published teardown.
steps.prose: The quote is reproduced exactly as the document's own text layer renders it; the printed page reads 'field stripping your firearm'.
steps.quote: Use caution when ield stripping your irearm, as spring and other parts may become dislodged during disassembly process!
steps.cite: Zastava ZPAPM70 Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — Owner's Manual and Safety Instructions — SECTION 5.1 Field Striping, caution, p.19

deepAbsentReason: Zastava publishes no procedure past the field strip. Sections 5.1 and 5.2 run strip then clean then reassemble; nothing in the ZPAPM70 book takes the bolt, the trigger group or the gas block apart, and the exploded parts view on pp.24-25 is a parts list, not a teardown. That absence is the manual's answer and no deeper procedure was invented to fill it.

cleaning.name: BARREL BORE
tasks: Clean the barrel of soot deposits with the barrel cleaner and rags, changing rags until the last one comes out clean
Lubricate the barrel with oil using the brush
Two to three days later, inspect the barrel and wipe it again until the rag comes out clean, then lubricate again

cleaning.name: CARRIER, BOLT & GAS TUBE
tasks: Wipe carbon from the bolt, the bolt face and the locking lugs
Clean the gas piston and the inside of the gas tube
Wipe the receiver rails and the carrier channel dry, then oil lightly

cleaning.name: BEFORE AND AFTER SHOOTING
tasks: Before shooting, wipe the rifle clean and leave the barrel dry
As soon as possible after firing, clean and wipe dry, then lubricate the barrel with oil
Before storing, clean thoroughly and apply a light coat of quality gun oil to all cleaned metal surfaces

reassembly: Refit the gas tube: front end into the gas block first, then the rear into its groove, and rotate the locking lever back down.
Return the bolt to the carrier, then run carrier and bolt onto the receiver rails from the rear.
Depress the recoil spring cam until its guide lugs are aligned with the channel on the top of the receiver rear plate.
Refit the dust cover and confirm the release button springs back and holds it.
fncheck: With the rifle confirmed empty, cycle the cocking handle and confirm the carrier runs and returns fully to battery, and that the safety lever moves between its notches.
